reason: $24.99 for the first box is under a dollar a day, and the money-back guarantee means I am not stuck if it does nothing for me. I would try one box at the launch price, not two.
objection: Two capsules every day is a pain, and it says made in China. The lab report on the page helps, but I would still check it before I trust it. I will not pay $29.99 without a deal, since I can find magnesium cheaper.
